summary.headline: Venus in the Planetary Terms
summary.text: Chapter 24 interprets Venus placed in her own terms and in the terms of Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars, describing effects on women, marriage, children, status, religion, wealth, reputation, and conduct. The preceding lines conclude the effects of Mercury’s terms, including writing, medicine, law, and proximity to kings.
